title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.15
exact_target: For almost every sign choice, does a polynomial with coefficients plus or minus one and no constant term have about half its zeros inside the unit disc?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304015 (AMR-022-4015). CC BY 4.0.
